thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty Alert: redis-prod maxclients exceeded on redis-primary (us-east-1)

pagerduty-bot: Pager fired — High: Redis maxclients (service: cache/redis-prod). Triggered at 2025-11-03T14:33:19Z

alice.g: acked + taking. I'm oncall.

bob.s: escalated — paging second oncall in 5m if not acked.

alice.g: quick status: 502/503 upstream rate is spiking for api-prod. Grafana shows connection failures to redis up to 85% over last 2m. Trying to confirm client cause.

carol: seeing a bunch of `ERR max number of clients reached` in redis logs on redis-primary-3

alice.g: copying logs:
```
Nov 03 14:31:04 redis[12345]:  #1: Accepting client connection: fd=12 addr=10.0.4.22:53210
Nov 03 14:31:05 redis[12345]:  #1: ERR max number of clients reached
```

dave: are we seeing connection leak from frontend? Any long-lived transactions?

alice.g: pgbouncer stats look normal but app pods show many idle connections piling up. Running quick check:
```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=api | wc -l
kubectl -n prod exec -it svc/pgbouncer -- psql -c "SHOW POOL_STATS;"
```

carol: redis-cli info clients shows connected_clients=1024 (maxclients=1024)

alice.g: manual mitigation plan: 1) temp increase maxclients on redis-primary to 2048 2) scale up redis read replicas 3) roll restart a subset of frontend pods to release leaked connections 4) enable local in-memory caching in API layer for hot keys

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook: redis-maxclients -> recommended immediate action: increase maxclients by 50% if replica catchup possible; if not, failover to replica after flushing clients.

bob.s: +1 for increasing maxclients temporarily. Who can bump config and restart redis with minimal downtime?

dave: I can do config change to redis conf and SIGHUP, but for maxclients a restart is required. Suggest spinning up a replacement node with higher maxclients and promoting if needed.

alice.g: I'll add capacity: scoping a new redis-primary-4 with instance type r6gd.xlarge, will bring online via terraform: `terraform apply -target=module.redis[1]` then reconfigure upstream.

carol: meanwhile, reduce app-side connection attempts: adding short-circuit to fallback to memcache for non-critical reads.

alice.g: quick command I'm running (watching):
```
# add temporary config and restart
kubectl -n infra apply -f redis-temp-maxclients-2048.yaml
kubectl -n infra rollout restart statefulset/redis-primary
```

pagerduty-bot: Note: Pager escalated to bob.s after 5 minutes unack.

bob.s: I'm here, coordinating with infra. Any customer-facing impact?

alice.g: initial blast radius: ~8% of API requests saw 502/503; few enterprise customers reported errors. SLO alert on 99p latency also triggered but mostly error-related.

dave: reached out to support channel to inform CS to prepare incident banner if this persists. Support ticket count: 4 for redis timeouts.

carol: new redis-primary-4 is provisioning, replication lag currently 0s, will divert writes once promoted.

alice.g: promoting now, swapping VIP. Command:
```
# promote replica
redis-cli -h redis-primary-4 SLAVEOF NO ONE
# update LB
kubectl -n infra patch svc/redis-primary -p '{"spec":{"externalIPs":["10.1.2.3"]}}'
```

alice.g: switched writes to new node. Observability: connected_clients dropped to 340, errors trending down.

pagerduty-bot: Alert acknowledged by alice.g, status: acknowledged -> resolved pending verification.

bob.s: good. Still seeing some client reconnect storms from older pods. Rolling restart staged: 25% of frontend pods now.

carol: applying temporary token bucket at edge to reduce retry thundering. patch:
```
# rate limiter
PATCH /svc/edge-config
{ "retry_backoff_ms": 1000 }
```

alice.g: monitoring — 503s dropped from 8% -> 0.7% in last 6 minutes.

dave: CS updated customers with interim note: "We are mitigating a caching backend issue; some requests may have transient errors. We'll follow up with root cause."

bob.s: action items to close incident:
- confirm redis stability 30m
- roll fix for leaked client connections in api (PR open)
- add health-checks to reduce retries
- update runbook with new autoscale play

alice.g: setting incident severity to Sev3 -> will keep mobilized for 45m. I will handoff to next oncall after 35m.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook updated: added section "redis dynamic maxclients scaling" (link: https://runbook.internal/redis-maxclients)

alice.g: handing off to bob.s for monitoring window, I'm on break. Handoff: all actions applied, new node promoted, Redis metrics stable. Last check: connected_clients=358, rejected=0

bob.s: taking over. I'll ping if anything regresses. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved by alice.g — Pager closed at 2025-11-03T15:01:58Z

carol: filing postmortem draft, noting leak in client pool and missing health-checks in frontend.

dave: quick follow-up: increase pgbouncer pool min to avoid connection bursts; will open PR.

alice.g: Thanks all. Closing thread once postmortem published.
